title: When "Create New" from the Context Menu is selected, or when dragging items; highlight the area it will be dropped/created
line: While you drag icons on the desktop, or pick something from "Create New", the grid cell where the item will land is now highlighted.
explanation: The desktop snaps dropped and newly created items to a grid cell computed from the drop point (rounded to the nearest cell edge) and moves them to the next free cell when that one is taken, but nothing showed which cell that would be, so items often landed one cell off. The cell computation in FolderView.qml is now a shared function used both by the actual move and by a new highlight: while dragging over the desktop, the landing cell of each dragged item is drawn with the same hover frame icons use (none when hovering a folder or file, which take the drop themselves). FolderModel gains a newItemPosition property that is set while the Create New submenu is open and while its name dialog is up, so the cell the new item will be placed in is highlighted too.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Highlight the cell where items will be placed

Nothing showed which grid cell a dragged item or one made from "Create
New" would land in, so they often ended up in a neighbouring cell. Show
a highlight on that cell while dragging and while creating new items.

BUG: 495067

media.caption: Master: dragging alpha.txt across the desktop gives no hint of the cell it will snap to
Fix: a frame follows the drag showing the landing cell (gone while over New Folder, which would take the drop), and the file lands exactly there
Master: Create New submenu open, nothing shows where the new item will go
Fix: with Create New open, the cell under the right-click point is highlighted (it stays during the name dialog; the folder was then created in that cell)
Master: dropping alpha.txt over the cell taken by Target silently moves it to the next cell
Fix: the same drop highlights the next free cell, where the file then lands
